omarchy-peek-desktop command: parks open windows in a hidden special workspace
omarchy-deadcells-map command: Dead Cells biome map theme picker
omarchy-toggle-widgets command: show or hide btop and cliamp widgets
omarchy-cliamp-toggle-provider command: switch cliamp between Spotify and local radio
omarchy-wallpaper-effect-toggle command: wallpaper vignette on or off
omarchy-dictation command: toggle, start, stop dictation
omarchy-system-lock command: lock the screen
omarchy-shell shell toggle command: opens shell panels such as omarchy.emojis
omarchy-menu toggle root command: Omarchy root menu
omarchy-capture-screenshot command: take a screenshot
voxtype record toggle command: voice recording
general gaps_in=2 gaps_out=4: smaller gaps between windows and screen edges
decoration rounding=12: window corner radius (shell mirrors this value)
decoration dim_inactive dim_strength=0.15: dims unfocused windows
decoration shadow enabled range=12 render_power=3
decoration blur size=8 passes=3 noise=0.08 new_optimizations: window blur
Blur is the costliest effect on the Iris Xe iGPU (no dGPU), so GPU load is watched
hl.animation settings with curves fluid and fluidOut: ~200-300ms macOS-like motion
animation leaf workspaces style=slide speed=3.2 (workspace slide animation)
animation leaves windowsIn and windowsOut style popin 94%
animation leaves layers, layersIn, layersOut style fade
animation leaf fadeSwitch enabled=false
general layout = dwindle (default workspace layout)
scrolling layout (niri-like columns): column_width 0.5, explicit_column_widths 0.333 0.5 0.667 1.0
Scrolling layout kept off: Hyprland 0.56.2 SIGSEGV in CScrollingFullscreenHandler when a workspace leaves scrolling; re-enable on Hyprland 0.57+
hl.gesture fingers=3 horizontal action=workspace: touchpad swipe switches workspaces
hl.gesture fingers=4 horizontal action=scroll_move: slides the column strip of the scrolling layout
touchpad options example (commented out): natural_scroll, clickfinger_behavior, scroll_factor, drag_3fg
o.window scroll_touchpad per app: Alacritty, kitty, foot 1.5; ghostty 0.2
hl.gesture 3-finger left and right focus via hl.dsp.focus (commented out)
launch_on_start btop widget: omarchy-launch-terminal app-id omarchy-widget-btop, title Widgets: btop, runs btop
launch_on_start cliamp widget: omarchy-launch-terminal app-id omarchy-widget-cliamp runs omarchy-widget-cliamp-launch
launch_on_start omarchy-wallpaper-effect-watch: vignette re-applies when theme changes
~/.local/state/omarchy/cliamp-provider state file: Spotify or local radio start mode
cliamp Spotify mode via bundled go-librespot, needs cliamp setup once for Spotify Premium
omarchy-launch-terminal command: launches a terminal with app-id and title
omarchy-widget-cliamp-launch command: starts cliamp in Spotify or radio mode
omarchy-wallpaper-effect-watch command: reapplies vignette on theme change
painting-theme.service systemd user unit: auto-switch painting theme (login, wake, timer); Troca automatica da pintura do tema
ExecStart=%h/.local/bin/painting-theme daemon
Restart=on-failure RestartSec=20 for painting-theme.service
graphical-session.target: After, PartOf, WantedBy ordering for painting-theme.service
painting-theme command (~/.local/bin/painting-theme): daemon, next, choose, config
[bar] section: size-horizontal 26, size-vertical 28, scale-with-font, active color red
[hyprland] active-border tokens from shell_gradient hyprland_active_border accent
[controls] normal, hover, focus, selected border alpha and fill alpha tokens (normal-border-alpha 0.18)
[spacing] control-height 30, popup-row-height 30, panel-padding 20, scale 1.0
[font] base-size 13: rem root for the type scale
[popups] elevated card: mix background foreground 7%, hairline border mix 16%, border-width 1
[menu] and [launcher] cards: scrim 0.35, selected-text accent, selection fill 0.10
[lock] and [polkit] sections: lock password input and sudo polkit prompt colors (lock not tested)
template variables background, foreground, accent, red, mix, shell_gradient used by shell.toml
colors.toml: active Omarchy theme palette that drives all color tokens
Corner radius is not a toml key: the shell mirrors Hyprland decoration rounding
Calm macOS and Spotlight-like shell look: elevated card with hairline border instead of accent gradient
pintura menu root: Pintura do tema, aliases pintura and paintings (wallpaper and colors from a painting)
pintura.next Trocar agora: painting-theme next
pintura.choose Escolher pintura: painting-theme choose
pintura.auto Automatico: toggles painting-theme config enabled (uses jq)
pintura.boot Ao ligar o PC: toggles painting-theme config on_boot
pintura.wake Ao acordar: toggles painting-theme config on_wake
pintura.bytime Por horario: toggles painting-theme config by_time
pintura.interval Trocar a cada: submenu setting interval_min
pintura.interval.m30 30 minutos: painting-theme config interval_min 30
pintura.interval.h1 1 hora: painting-theme config interval_min 60
pintura.interval.h3 3 horas: painting-theme config interval_min 180
pintura.interval.h6 6 horas: painting-theme config interval_min 360
pintura.interval.off Nunca (so manual): painting-theme config interval_min 0
jq command: reads painting-theme JSON config for menu checked state
starship format [$directory$git_branch$git_status]($style)$character
[character] success_symbol bold cyan, error_symbol bold red
[directory] truncation_length 2, truncation_symbol, style bold magenta, repo_root_style bold cyan
[git_branch] format and style italic yellow
[git_status] symbols: ahead, behind, diverged, conflicted, untracked, modified, staged, style red
Prompt uses terminal ANSI colors so it follows the active Omarchy colors.toml theme
